title: Senior SMPP & Telecom Protocol Engineer
description: We are seeking a seasoned SMPP & Telecom Protocol Engineer to architect, optimize, and scale our core SMSC firewall and SS7/SMPP routing engine handling hundreds of millions of transactions daily.
responsibilities: Architect and scale high-throughput SMPP 3.4 v5 nodes and SS7/SIGTRAN protocol stacks.
Optimize low-latency message queuing, throughput, and failover across multi-region cloud nodes.
Collaborate with MNO carriers to integrate direct SS7/SMPP routes and troubleshoot traffic anomalies.
Develop automated monitoring, grey-route detection, and anti-spam firewall rules.
requirements: 5+ years experience in CPaaS, SMS gateway architecture, or telecom protocol engineering.
Deep expertise in SMPP, SS7, SIGTRAN, HTTP/REST, and TCP IP socket communications.
Proficiency in C/C++, Rust, Go, or high-performance Node.js / Java.
Familiarity with carrier interconnection, HLR/MNP lookups, and telecom compliance.
benefits: Competitive global USD salary with performance bonuses.
Flexible hybrid/remote working environment with home office stipend.
Comprehensive health insurance and annual team retreats.
Work with cutting-edge carrier-grade infrastructure powering global tier-1 brands.
